findings.explanation: Only the Client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, which creates an unequal termination right.
findings.suggested_change: Either Party has the right to terminate this Agreement at any time, at its sole discretion, upon providing one hundred eighty (180) days' written notice to the other Party.

findings.explanation: Payment terms of sixty days exceed the standard thirty-day threshold, delaying your receipt of milestone compensation.
findings.suggested_change: (a) An amount of one million dollars ($1,000,000) upon Net Sales first exceeding an amount of ten million dollars ($10,000,000) in a calendar year to be paid within thirty (30) days after the calendar year end.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together and would like to request one minor adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the sixty-day payment terms delay the receipt of milestone compensation, so I propose updating this to thirty days: (a) An amount of one million dollars ($1,000,000) upon Net Sales first exceeding an amount of ten million dollars ($10,000,000) in a calendar year to be paid within thirty (30) days after the calendar year end. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards
